versions.changelog: Sync existing infra403/opentwitter-mcp from https://github.com/6551Team/opentwitter-mcp, main commit 8d69ca5e856f2026fde6b1903f6e06d63bab0770, directory openclaw-skill/opentwitter. Exact upstream SKILL.md and package.json; generated skill-card.md excluded. Adds meme token evidence/activity documentation and watch groupName parameter. Existing owner, slug and display name preserved. No example commands executed.

- Now uses OPENNEWS_TOKEN for authentication instead of TWITTER_TOKEN.
- Authentication and API usage documentation updated for the new token system and signup link.
- Added support for a raw `query` parameter in Twitter search for more advanced filter flexibility.
- New endpoints: fetch Twitter articles by ID and get tweets (with context) by ID.
- Minor adjustments: updated sample requests, removed old doc file, and added a package.json file.

Initial release of opentwitter: Twitter/X data from the 6551 API

- Query Twitter/X user profiles, tweets, search, follower events, deleted tweets, and KOL followers via the 6551 API.
- Requires a Bearer token via the environment variable `TWITTER_TOKEN`.
- Supports endpoints for user info, user by ID, user tweets (with filtering), tweet search (with advanced filters), follower/unfollower events, deleted tweets, and KOL follower lookup.
- Provides example cURL usage and parameter details for all endpoints.
- Includes sample data structures for users and tweets.
